pricing.details: Free 0 € — 3,000 credits / 90 days, 1 member, 1 small cloud sandbox and 1 routine, 200 MB memory, 30-day history. Pro 18 €/month — 10,000 credits/month, additional usage as needed, up to 5 members, 3 sandboxes (up to standard) and 10 routines, 2 GB memory, 1-year history. Team 181 €/month — 100,000 credits/month, up to 50 members, 10 sandboxes (up to large) and 50 routines. Enterprise custom.
